changelog: v0.5.2: 1) Fixed Neural TTS hang on Quest 3 by adding serialized ONNX inference mutex, in-flight warmup deduplication, 10s per-sentence timeouts, and graceful Web Speech fallback; 2) Fixed SmolLM2 repetition loops and high latency by adding temperature sampling (0.6), repetition penalty (1.12), and max_new_tokens (28); 3) Added automatic speech clause deduplication; 4) Added instant 0ms responses for 'what can you do' and 'can you repeat'.
